The '''2014 National Hurling League''' was the 83rd staging of the [[National Hurling League]]. The league began on 15 February.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gaa.ie/content/files/Allianz%20League%202014.pdf|title=2014 National League Fixtures|work=GAA.ie|access-date=14 January 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140116072149/http://www.gaa.ie/content/files/Allianz%20League%202014.pdf|archive-date=16 January 2014|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
The divisional stage of the competition finished on 23 March.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://www.independent.ie/sport/hurling/league-sheds-light-on-summer-prospects-30121519.html|title= League sheds light on summer prospects|date=24 March 2014|work=Irish Independent|access-date=25 March 2014}}</ref>

In the final played on 4 May at [[Semple Stadium]], [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] defeated [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] by 2-25 1–27 with [[TJ Reid]] getting the winning point in the last minute of extra-time.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thescore.ie/kilkenny-tipperary-allianz-hurling-league-final-report-1448498-May2014/|title=Kilkenny win third Allianz Hurling League in a row with last-gasp win over Tipperary|date=4 May 2014|work=The Score|access-date=7 May 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140508025318/http://www.thescore.ie/kilkenny-tipperary-allianz-hurling-league-final-report-1448498-May2014/|archive-date=8 May 2014|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
Tipperary had led by 1–11 to 1–9 at half time, the Tipperary goal coming from [[John O'Dwyer]] when he connected with Noel McGrath's sideline cut to touch the ball to the net from the edge of the square. The game finished in a draw at 2–17 to 1–20 after 70 minutes with injury time points for Tipperary from Shane Bourke and Kieran Bergin sending the game to extra time.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://munster.gaa.ie/2014/05/04/ahl-division-1-final-tipperary-v-kilkenny/|title= Kilkenny claim third consecutive league crown|date=4 May 2014|work=Munster GAA |access-date=7 May 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/arid-20267525.html|title= Cats edge yet another classic|date=5 May 2014|work=Irish Examiner|access-date=7 May 2014}}</ref>
Both goals for Kilkenny came from penalties and both scored by TJ Reid and the sides were level 11 times.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://www.independent.ie/sport/kilkenny-edge-tipperary-in-absorbing-league-decider-after-extra-time-30242910.html|title= Kilkenny edge Tipperary in absorbing league decider after extra time|date=4 May 2014|work=Irish Independent |access-date=7 May 2014}}</ref>

==Format==

*'''Division 1A:''' Top four teams qualify for NHL quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gaa.ie/gaa-news-and-videos/daily-news/1/2403141246-allianz-hurling-league-fixture-details-confirmed/ |title = Allianz Hurling League Fixture Details Confirmed {{!}} Daily News {{!}} GAA News {{!}} GAA.ie  |access-date=2014-03-24 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140324184420/http://www.gaa.ie/gaa-news-and-videos/daily-news/1/2403141246-allianz-hurling-league-fixture-details-confirmed/ |archive-date=24 March 2014 }}</ref> Bottom two teams play a relegation playoff, with the losing team relegated to Division 1B.
*'''Division 1B:''' Top team promoted to 1A. Top four teams qualify for NHL quarter-finals. Bottom two teams play a relegation playoff, with the losing team playing a promotion-relegation match against the Division 2A champions.
*'''Division 2A''': Top two teams play Division 2A final, with the winning team playing a promotion-relegation match against the loser of the Division 1B relegation playoff. Bottom team relegated to Division 2B.
*'''Division 2B:''' Top two teams play division final, with the winner being promoted. Bottom two teams play a relegation playoff, with the losing team playing a promotion-relegation match against the Division 3A champions.
*'''Division 3A''': Top two teams play Division 3A final, with the winning team playing a promotion-relegation match against the loser of the Division 2B relegation playoff. Bottom team relegated to Division 3B.
*'''Division 3B:''' Top two teams play division final, with the winner being promoted.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.wexfordgaa.ie/2013/11/allianz-national-hurling-league-fixtures-structure-for-2014/|title = Allianz National Hurling League fixtures & structure for 2014|date = 20 November 2013}}</ref>
